tools.name: defi-intelligence_protocols_search
tools.description: Search DeFi protocols by name, symbol, description, category, or chain using the DeFiLlama public API. Filtering is performed client-side. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/defi-intelligence/protocols/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: defi-intelligence_protocols_profile
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific DeFi protocol by ID or slug from DeFiLlama public API. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/defi-intelligence/protocols/profile. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current
tools.description: Retrieve current Total Value Locked (TVL) for a specific DeFi protocol from DeFiLlama public API. TVL is a delayed reference value. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/defi-intelligence/protocols/tvl/current. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: defi-intelligence_chains_tvl
tools.description: Retrieve Total Value Locked (TVL) across blockchains from DeFiLlama public API v2. TVL is a delayed reference value. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/defi-intelligence/chains/tvl. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "defi-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: defi-intelligence_protocols_search, defi-intelligence_protocols_profile, defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current, defi-intelligence_chains_tvl · Public sink: defi-intelligence_protocols_search, defi-intelligence_protocols_profile, defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current, defi-intelligence_chains_tvl · Destructive: defi-intelligence_protocols_search, defi-intelligence_protocols_profile, defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current, defi-intelligence_chains_tvl.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: defi-intelligence_protocols_search, defi-intelligence_protocols_profile, defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current, defi-intelligence_chains_tvl · Public sink: defi-intelligence_protocols_search, defi-intelligence_protocols_profile, defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current, defi-intelligence_chains_tvl · Destructive: defi-intelligence_protocols_search, defi-intelligence_protocols_profile, defi-intelligence_protocols_tvl_current, defi-intelligence_chains_tvl

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
